visual_appeal: Raise every content well off pure black: panel fill #1a1612, inset well #12100e, 1px inner stroke #8a7040 and 8px padding so the roster is not a flat void.
Hero portrait is 38px beside a 28px name and reads as a bullet. Make it 64px, add 12px below the speech line, and keep the 1.5 figure at 36px so the card has a focal point.
The options page is a different, washed taupe slab. Rebuild it on the same dark panel as the roster; the about blurb in yellow on brown looks unfinished.
play_next_clarity: Set the kicker to 14px Friz Quadrata #f0d080 with a 4px left bar in #e6c56a. At ~10px it loses to the 1.5 figure.

Replace the sentence in body gold with a 22px primary button Play Le Dette and a 13px secondary line Hearth Le Jette to an inn first. The current line matches surrounding text and does not look like the action.
Delete the empty black track and the line 0.0 rested levels left in NOW PLAYING. They look like a broken bar and repeat the NOT RESTING chip. One line: Not banking. Log out in an inn.
state_colours: Legend dots are ~8px. Use 10px circles with a 1px #000 ring, 6px apart, so green #3cba4c, yellow #e6c020, orange #e07a2f and red #d64545 separate at a glance.
RESTING chips are generic gold #c4a15a, which collides with nearly-full yellow. Tint each quiet chip with its row colour at 85% (orange row chip #e07a2f, not gold).

On the timeline, stop laying dates on the faded tail. Keep the bar solid until the clip edge and put Full Wed 2 Dec in 12px #f4e6c4 in a reserved 132px right column. Night bands at about 60% blue crush the orange; drop them to #1a2744 at 35% opacity.
character_identity: Race/gender badges are ~12px and unreadable. Draw them at 18px with a 2px #f4efe6 ring, bottom-right of the 36px class icon.
Hero subtitle Level 6 Gnome Warlock is the same dim #9a8a70 as the inn line. Set race and class at 13px #e8dcc0 and leave only the location and seen-ago in #9a8a70.

Saved-look card: pin a 96px portrait to a 120px left column, speech bubble 8px above it, stats in a two-column grid with 12px row gaps. Add a 3px class-colour left edge (druid #ff7d0a). The current face sits in a large empty middle.
default_theme: Scene 02 is still the ElvUI near-black layout. Use a classic dialog: 32px gold edge, fill #2a2018, inset #3d2e22, title 16px Friz #ffd100.
Unlink stays a blue ElvUI button in the default scene. Every default button must be UIPanelButtonTemplate stone, 22px tall, including Unlink, All accounts and Close.
Keep the tavern hero art, but add a bottom gradient #000000 at 45% over the lower 48px so the name and bar stay legible.
elvui_wc3_fit: The roster frame is a 1px gold stroke. Load the Gatewood dialog backdrop, border and corner ornaments the character window uses, not a flat rectangle.
Options selection highlight is gold. ElvUI lists use a blue bar (#1a4a7a fill, #3d7ec0 edge). Match that, and match Close at 22px on the same blue template as Move notifications.
Options body and the GPL about line fail contrast on the taupe fill. Body 13px #e6d7b0 on #1a1612; about text 11px #b8a88a, not yellow #d6c04a.
alerts_ux: Cancel the logout first and Find an inn before you log out share almost the same body. Use one title, Logout outside a rest area, and one body: Le Jette will not bank XP. Hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold or reach an inn, then log out.
Move mode shows Reset only on the toast. Add a 22px Reset at the top-right of the logout banner and the Esc card, same style as the toast.

Remove the stray 1px white line and the unlabelled gray square in the move overlay. Relabel the center card Drag the highlighted cards (16px), and replace the toast dump Filled up, ran out, running low, sleeping bag. with one example: Le Bankken is nearly full, 19h 11m left.
readability: Secondary row text (level, inn, seen-ago) is under ~12px and near #8a7b66. Minimum 12px #d2c4a8. Same for the compact footer hint.
Timeline axis labels (12:00, Wed, +48H) are ~11px #a89880. Use 12px #e4d2b0. LEVELS BANKED at ~10px should be 11px #f3e6c4 with 1px tracking.
Options helper lines under checkboxes and the low-rest caption are gray-on-brown. Set them to 12px #d7cbb6. Do not use yellow for paragraph text.
layout_polish: Footer controls do not share a metric: blue Unlink ~20px, gold All accounts ~24px, checkbox floating. Use one 22px row, 8px gaps: Unlink 80px, flex status, filter 110px, checkbox 12px from the right edge.
NOW PLAYING bar is a tall empty track unlike the 13px roster bars. Use the same 13px height, center the 32px face with the name and the chip, and align the chip column with the roster chips.
Reserve 140px on the timeline for date labels so Full Fri 25 Dec does not sit on the bar. Active tab ROSTER or TIMELINE needs a 2px #f0d080 underline and #fff2cc; inactive #9a8b72.
delight: The imp line is an 11px gray bubble. Set it at 14px #f3ead6 directly under the name, and rotate three short lines so the hero is not a spreadsheet header.
Echo the timeline Full now pill (green fill, 11px #0e1a10 text, 4px radius) on the hero next to Full for 1d 16h so the reward is a status, not a caption.
On the saved-look card, draw the three z glyphs at 14px #f4efe6, staggered 4px, 6px above the portrait. That is the only charm on an otherwise empty card.

overall_notes: Clearer than the 1.1.2 baseline: one red, thicker bars, a real timeline, and an explicit play-next sentence. It is still an admin panel. The default theme barely leaves the ElvUI palette, the options page does not wear Gatewood, the character card is mostly empty, and move mode looks unfinished. I would not ship this to a demanding user until the hero is an unmistakable action, the two themes use different chrome, and alert/move-mode copy and contrast are cleaned up.
